course_name_en: Programming and Simulation of Technical Systems

learning_outcomes.text: Determine which sensors and actuators are necessary for simple tasks and know their electrical and information technology interfaces.
Design and program simple systems with multiple actuators and sensors.
Formulate equations for describing dynamic systems in mechanical engineering.
Realize a test-bed for simple systems using plug-in technology.
Know the data model and fundamental commands of Matlab.
Create small programs for design and simulation.
Know the idea of iterative simulation and apply this approach to solve differential equations in the time domain.
Know the programming language Simulink and implement differential equations in programs.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to Systems Engineering methods for the design of technical systems
Introduction to the construction of plug-in test environments (Breadboard, encased SoC, etc.)
Introduction to the Matlab/Simulink programming system
Principle of simulation as an iterative solution of differential equations
Modeling of simple dynamic systems using differential equations (Modeling)
Programming of simulations with the text-based Matlab programming system
Implementation of models in the graphical programming language Simulink
